name: io.github.OWNER/cardano-defi-mcp
title: BazaarSwap Cardano
description: Cardano DeFi taxonomy plus unsigned-transaction MCP tools for agents (holds no keys)

environmentVariables.name: BLOCKFROST_PROJECT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Blockfrost project id; required for get_balance, open_cdp and close_cdp

environmentVariables.name: BAZAAR_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: BazaarSwap routing API base URL used by get_quote and build_swap_tx

environmentVariables.name: CARDANO_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Cardano network for Blockfrost and Indigo host selection

environmentVariables.name: INDIGO_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Indigo public analytics API used for CDP position reads

environmentVariables.name: INDIGO_SYSTEM_PARAMS_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of the Indigo SystemParams JSON; required by open_cdp and close_cdp
